text: This was diagnosed as a binding mistake, so the fix matches exactly. Click the Executive Summary's headline Total Sales card, remove Total Sales All Regions from the Values well, and drag in the plain Total Sales measure instead. Nothing about either measure's DAX changes. Both stay correct.

A fix only checked against the one reported region isn't fully validated. Go through every territory and confirm the Executive Summary now changes correctly and matches the Drill-Down page. Then clear the slicer entirely and confirm both pages still show the full company total — you want to be sure you didn't just hide the symptom in one case while breaking another.

The root cause was two similarly-named measures sitting right next to each other in an alphabetized list. The fix above doesn't change that risk for the next person building a card. So rename Total Sales All Regions to something more defensive, like Total Sales, Company Benchmark, ALL Territories.

That rename is safe. Pct of Company Total references the measure by object, not by typed text, so Power BI Desktop updates that formula automatically. Confirm it directly: open Pct of Company Total after the rename and check the formula shows the new name, still returning the same number.

Group both benchmark measures into a display folder named Benchmarks, separating them from the plain, filter-responsive measures in the Fields pane. Next lesson: documenting this solution properly, so it never has to be diagnosed from scratch twice.
